name: Giga-Byte Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Giga-Byte Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, processes, and trades in computer hardware peripherals and components in Taiwan, Europe, America, Canada, Singapore, Japan, China, Malaysia, and internationally. It operates through Brand Business Group; and Other Business Group segments. The company offers motherboards, graphic cards, laptops, monitors, storage devices, and desktop. It also provides PC peripherals, such as keyboards, mouse products, headsets, and gaming chairs; and PC components comprising PC cases, CPU coolers, power supply products, PC accessory, and memory and SSD products, as well as DIY kits.
